quests.title: Another Horizon of Adventure

dialogue.t: Ad astra abyssosque! Welcome to the Adventurers' Guild. Is there something I can help you with?
It's... Katheryne again. This one must be a puppet too...
Is there something I can help you with? Are you looking to take on a commission? Or send one out?
I see... If you've run into any guild-related issues, you can come and ask me.
I will provide the utmost service for you and answer all answerable questions.
Then we thank you for your contributions to the guild, adventurer. We wish you smooth travels!

quests.description: Ah, Fontaine! Another nation… another Katheryne…
